documents.opening: MERIDIAN MARITIME - CONDUCT, GRIEVANCE AND BUSINESS TRAVEL Policy HR-310, effective 1 January 2026 1. Code of conduct Meridian Maritime has zero tolerance for harassment, bullying and discrimination. Gifts or hospitality with a value above 50 USD from suppliers or customers must be declared to the Compliance Officer. Any conflict of interest must be disclosed to the line manager within 14 days of the employee becoming aware of it. 2.
